title: 故郷 (Furusato — My Hometown)
description: One of Japan's most beloved songs about homesickness and longing for one's birthplace. Written in 1914 for the sixth-grade Ministry of Education songbook, it evokes childhood memories of chasing rabbits in the mountains and catching fish in streams. The final verse speaks of returning home one day after achieving one's aspirations — a sentiment that resonates with every generation.
